title: Preparation and characterization of novel PMMA bone cement containing 3,4-dichloro-5-hydroxyfuran-2(5H)-one
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,806-813
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06607C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wen-Han Bu, Ayakuzi Asilebieke, Lu-Yang Han, Yang Xu, Tao Zhou, Jian-Jun Chu
A novel antibacterial non-leaching bone cement based 3,4-dichloro-5-hydroxyfuran-2(5H)-one (DHF) was synthesized. We refer to it as DHF-MAA cement, and it exhibits excellent antibacterial activity, compressive properties, and biocompatibility.
